description: Gemini 1.5 Pro is Google's most capable multimodal model with a groundbreaking 2 million token context window. It uses a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architecture for efficient processing of long documents, code, audio, and video content.

primaryUses: Code generation and understanding across large codebases
Cross-modal reasoning with text, images, audio, and video

trainingData.description: Trained on a diverse corpus of text, images, audio, and video data. Specific training data composition is proprietary.

trainingProcedure: Trained using advanced techniques including instruction tuning and RLHF. Specific methodology is proprietary.

evaluation.performanceSummary: State-of-the-art performance on long-context tasks. Can process up to 1 hour of video, 11 hours of audio, or 30,000+ lines of code in a single context.

knownLimitations: Higher latency and cost compared to Gemini 1.5 Flash
May generate incorrect or misleading information
Cannot access real-time information or browse the internet
May exhibit biases present in training data
Video and audio processing has additional latency

ethicalConsiderations.biasAndFairness: Google applies safety training and evaluation to reduce harmful outputs and biases.
ethicalConsiderations.safetyMeasures: Built-in safety filters, content moderation, and usage policies.
ethicalConsiderations.privacyConsiderations: API data handling governed by Google Cloud terms. Enterprise options available for additional privacy.

access.license: Proprietary - Google Cloud Terms of Service

requirements.deployment: API-only (cloud-hosted by Google), also available via Vertex AI
